title: Recorded removal next year, listed firms versus others, by prior state and era
question: Are listed firms removed from the register at different rates than other firms, by prior availability?
notes_text: Source: RFSD v3.1.0, foundation transition accounting by supplied membership. Origins are eligible firms registered at the preceding year-end, split by prior original availability and by exact membership in the named supplied file; the others line includes members of the other lists. Panels are not additive across lists. Hollow points have fewer than 50 origins. Removal takes precedence over a dissolution-year statement; a missing destination row is not an exit. No transition crosses the 2018 to 2019 provider change (shaded). Lists are fixed supplied files, not dated designations. Descriptive associations only.
reading: Listed firms are rarely removed from the register even when absent: 1 to 4 percent against 31 percent for other absent firms in 2024.
